# 9xenai: full reference

> 9xenai is an AI automation, consulting and software company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It builds and operates AI chatbots, WhatsApp assistants, voice agents, workflow automation, enterprise LLM systems and data platforms for organisations in Bangladesh, the Middle East, Europe and other markets. Work starts with a free 30-minute AI opportunity assessment and fixed-scope pilots measured against an agreed KPI. Delivery is in Bangla and English.

## Company
9xenai, House-234, Road No-21, Block F, Bashundhara R/A, Dhaka-1229, Bangladesh. Email: 9xenaiii@protonmail.com. Website: https://9xenai.com/

## Pricing (indicative, US dollars; each project gets a fixed written quote)
- AI Workflow Automation: $1,500 to $4,000 implementation fee (CRM automation, lead follow-ups, email automation, internal workflows)
- AI Chatbot Systems: $1,000 to $3,000 implementation fee (website assistants, customer support, knowledge-base integration, lead qualification)
- AI Voice Agents: $2,000 to $5,000 implementation fee (phone receptionists, appointment scheduling, missed-call follow-ups, inquiry handling)
- AI Consultancy and Implementation: $2,500 to $7,500 consulting engagement (readiness audits, process analysis, roadmaps, training and governance)
- Monthly plans: Essential support $500; Growth automation $1,000; Advanced AI operations $2,000; Enterprise AI partnership $3,000 to $5,000+. All include monitoring, maintenance, optimisation, reporting and a defined support allowance. Substantial new development and usage costs are charged separately.
- Details: https://9xenai.com/pricing/

## AI Strategy & Consulting
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/strategy/
Find out where AI pays back, and where it doesn’t, before you commit budget.
Built for: Executives and transformation leads deciding where to invest.
Target outcome: 3 weeks (from first interview to a ranked AI roadmap)
Included:
- AI readiness assessment: We score your data, systems, processes and team skills.
- Business AI roadmap: Ranked use cases with cost, effort and expected return.
- Transformation consulting: Leadership alignment, change planning and staff training.
- Implementation strategy: Build, buy or partner decisions and a 12-month delivery plan.
Works with: Board and steering packs, Business case models, Vendor assessments
How it runs: Interview teams and leaders > Map the current processes > Score each use case by return > Deliver the ranked roadmap
Delivery phases:
- Interviews, process maps and a data review.
- A scoring workshop and a draft roadmap for leaders to challenge.
- Final roadmap, business case and support choosing the first pilot.
Questions:
- Q: Do we need clean data first? A: Not always. The assessment shows which use cases can start now and which need data work first.
- Q: Can we use the roadmap with other suppliers? A: Yes. The roadmap is yours and is written to be supplier-neutral.

## AI Automation Solutions
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/automation/
Software handles the repetitive work. Your people approve the exceptions.
Built for: Operations, finance and administration teams with high-volume manual work.
Target outcome: 60% (of routine task time typically targeted for removal)
Included:
- Workflow automation: Approvals, routing and reminders that run on their own.
- AI agents: Assistants that read, decide and act across your tools.
- CRM and ERP automation: Records, quotes and orders updated without retyping.
- Email and document automation: Invoices, contracts and inboxes read, sorted and filed.
Works with: CRM and ERP systems, Email and shared drives, WhatsApp, Spreadsheets and databases
How it runs: A document or email arrives > AI reads it and classifies it > Your CRM or ERP is updated > A person reviews only the exceptions
Delivery phases:
- Select one process and baseline how long it takes today.
- Build the automation and run it beside the manual process.
- Switch over, then add the next process.
Questions:
- Q: Will it replace our staff? A: The aim is to remove retyping and chasing so teams spend time on work that needs judgement.
- Q: Which systems can it connect to? A: Most CRMs, ERPs, email, spreadsheets and messaging tools through standard connectors or APIs.

## WhatsApp & Chatbot Solutions
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/chatbots/
A chatbot that answers, sells and books on WhatsApp, Messenger and your website, 24 hours a day.
Built for: Shops, clinics, agencies and service teams whose customers already message them on WhatsApp.
Target outcome: 7 days (typical time to a first live WhatsApp chatbot)
Included:
- WhatsApp Business chatbot: Official WhatsApp Business API bot that answers FAQs, shares prices and hands over to your team.
- Order, booking and payment bots: Take orders, book appointments and send payment links inside the chat.
- Messenger, Instagram and website bots: One brain answering on every channel your customers use.
- Broadcasts and follow-up automation: Approved templates for offers, reminders and abandoned-order nudges.
Works with: WhatsApp Business API, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM, Website chat, CRM and Google Sheets
How it runs: A customer messages your WhatsApp number > The bot answers in Bangla or English from approved content > Orders, bookings or leads are captured > Your team takes over complex chats with the full history
Delivery phases:
- Collect FAQs, price lists and tone of voice; apply for the WhatsApp Business API.
- Build and test the bot with real questions, with human hand-over on every flow.
- Go live, review chats weekly and add orders, payments and broadcasts.
Questions:
- Q: Do I need the official WhatsApp Business API? A: For a real chatbot, yes. We handle the application, number setup and message templates for you.
- Q: Can the bot reply in Bangla and Banglish? A: Yes. We test with Bangla, English and mixed-language messages including Romanised Bangla.
- Q: Can a person take over the chat? A: Always. The bot passes the conversation, with its history, to your team when it is unsure or the customer asks.

## AI Vision & Document Intelligence
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/vision/
Read documents, images and video automatically, and flag only what needs a person.
Built for: Finance, logistics, HR and manufacturing teams buried in paperwork or visual checks.
Target outcome: 90% (target reduction in manual data entry from documents)
Included:
- OCR and document extraction: Pull fields from invoices, NID cards, forms and bank statements, including Bangla text.
- Image classification and quality inspection: Spot defects, count items and verify photos at scale.
- Video and CCTV analytics: Count people, detect events and trigger alerts.
- Identity and form verification: Match documents against records and highlight mismatches.
Works with: Scanners and phone cameras, Shared drives, ERP and accounting, CCTV and IP cameras
How it runs: A document or image arrives > AI reads and extracts the data > Values are checked against your records > Exceptions go to a person, the rest is filed
Delivery phases:
- Collect sample documents and define the fields to extract.
- Train and test on your real files, side by side with manual entry.
- Switch over and connect to your accounting or ERP system.
Questions:
- Q: Does it read Bangla documents? A: Yes. We test extraction on your own Bangla and English documents before committing.
- Q: What if the AI is unsure? A: Low-confidence fields are flagged and sent to a person for review rather than guessed.

## Enterprise LLM & Generative AI
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/llm/
Private, governed language-model assistants that answer from your own documents, systems and policies.
Built for: Enterprises, banks and large teams that want ChatGPT-style productivity without exposing company data.
Target outcome: 4 weeks (typical time to a secure internal assistant on real data)
Included:
- Private LLM deployment: Run open-weight or hosted models inside your cloud, your servers or a local provider.
- RAG knowledge assistants: Search and answer across policies, contracts, manuals and tickets, with source citations.
- Enterprise copilots and agents: Assistants that draft, decide and act in your CRM, ERP, email and ticketing tools, with approvals.
- Prompt engineering and evaluation: Tested prompts, guardrails and automatic quality scoring before and after launch.
- Model selection and cost optimisation: Pick the right model for each task and cut token spend without losing quality.
Works with: Open-weight and hosted LLMs, Vector databases, SharePoint, Drive and wikis, CRM, ERP and ticketing, Single sign-on
How it runs: Connect and secure your documents > Index them and add access rules > Test answers against a gold question set > Launch with citations, logging and review
Delivery phases:
- Choose use cases, data sources and access rules; set the evaluation questions.
- Build the assistant, test accuracy and safety, and tune with real users.
- Roll out, monitor quality and cost, and add new data sources and agents.
Questions:
- Q: Will our data be used to train public models? A: No. We design so your data stays in the environment you choose and is not used to train third-party models. This is agreed in writing.
- Q: How do you stop the model making things up? A: Answers are grounded in your documents with citations, low-confidence cases are flagged, and we measure accuracy on a test set before launch.
- Q: Can it respect who is allowed to see what? A: Yes. Retrieval follows your existing permissions, so people only get answers from documents they may already access.

## Custom Model Training & Fine-tuning
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/training/
Models trained on your data and language, when a general model is not accurate or cheap enough.
Built for: Organisations with proprietary data, strict accuracy needs or a language and domain that general models handle poorly.
Target outcome: 6 weeks (typical time from data audit to a tested custom model)
Included:
- LLM fine-tuning: Adapt a model to your terminology, tone and tasks using your approved data.
- Bangla and domain language models: Models and embeddings tuned for Bangla, Banglish and your industry vocabulary.
- Classical machine learning: Forecasting, scoring, churn and fraud models on tabular business data.
- Data labelling and synthetic data: Annotation workflows and safe synthetic data to improve training sets.
- Benchmarking and model evaluation: Side-by-side tests against general models, with accuracy, cost and speed reported.
Works with: Your data warehouse and files, Annotation tools, GPU cloud or on-premise GPUs, Experiment tracking
How it runs: Audit the data and define the target metric > Prepare, label and split the data > Train and compare against a general model > Deploy the winner with monitoring
Delivery phases:
- Data audit, success metric and a baseline using an off-the-shelf model.
- Prepare data and train candidate models, evaluated on held-out data.
- Deploy the chosen model, hand over the pipeline and monitor drift.
Questions:
- Q: Do we really need to train our own model? A: Often not. We first test a general model with good prompts and retrieval. We recommend training only when the numbers show it is worth the cost.
- Q: How much data is needed? A: It depends on the task. Fine-tuning can work with hundreds to a few thousand good examples; we tell you honestly after the data audit.
- Q: Who owns the trained model? A: You do. Model weights, training code and documentation are handed over, as set out in the agreement.

Included:
- AI policy and governance framework: Roles, approval steps and acceptable-use rules written for your organisation.
- AI risk assessment: Review of data, bias, privacy, security and operational risk for each use case.
- Security testing and red-teaming: Tests for prompt injection, data leakage and misuse before launch.
- Audit logs and human-in-the-loop controls: Traceable decisions and approval steps for high-risk actions.
- Staff awareness and training: Practical training on safe and approved use of AI tools.
Works with: Existing risk registers, Identity and access management, Logging and SIEM tools, Regulator and customer questionnaires
How it runs: Inventory current and planned AI use > Assess risks by use case > Set controls, policy and logging > Train staff and review quarterly

- Inventory AI use and map it to your policies and regulators.
- Assess risks and design controls, logging and approvals.
- Roll out the policy, train staff and set a review schedule.
Questions:
- Q: Are you a certified auditor? A: No. We help you design and operate controls and prepare evidence. Formal certification or legal advice comes from your auditor or counsel.
- Q: Does this slow down AI projects? A: Done well it speeds them up, because use cases follow a clear approval path instead of waiting on case-by-case debates.

## Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/agents/
Teams of specialised AI agents that plan, use your tools and hand risky steps to a person.
Built for: Operations and technology leaders whose work spans several systems and steps.
Target outcome: 1 process (end to end, run by agents with human approval points)
Included:
- Single-task agents: Agents that read a request, use your tools and finish a defined task.
- Multi-agent workflows: Researcher, drafter and checker agents that work in sequence on one process.
- Tool and API integration: Safe, permissioned access to your CRM, ERP, email and databases.
- Human approval and guardrails: Spending limits, action limits and sign-off for anything with financial or customer impact.
Works with: CRM and ERP, Email and calendars, Databases, Ticketing tools, Model APIs or private models
How it runs: A request or event arrives > A planner agent splits it into steps > Specialist agents act through approved tools > A person approves any high-risk action
Delivery phases:
- Choose one multi-step process and map every decision and system it touches.
- Build the agents, test against real cases and set action limits.
- Run with approvals on, review the activity log weekly, then widen the limits.
Questions:
- Q: Can agents act without approval? A: Only for low-risk actions you list in advance. Anything with financial, legal or customer impact waits for a named approver.
- Q: How do you stop agents going wrong? A: Limited tool permissions, spending caps, an evaluation set run before every release and a full log of every action.

## AI Risk, Fraud & Anomaly Detection
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/risk/
Spot unusual transactions, documents and behaviour early, and explain why each was flagged.
Built for: Finance, compliance and operations teams reviewing high transaction volumes.
Target outcome: Daily (target review cadence instead of month-end sampling)
Included:
- Transaction anomaly detection: Flag outliers in payments, claims, expenses and orders.
- Document fraud checks: Compare invoices, IDs and statements for inconsistencies.
- Risk scoring: Rank cases for review with a plain-language reason for each.
- Alert triage: Group alerts and cut false positives so analysts review what matters.
Works with: ERP and finance systems, Payment data, Case management tools, Data warehouse
How it runs: Transactions and documents are collected > Models score each item > Flags come with a clear reason > Analysts confirm or clear each case and the model learns
Delivery phases:
- Define what counts as risk and gather labelled historical cases.
- Run the model beside your current checks and compare findings.
- Move to daily review with analyst feedback built in.
Questions:
- Q: Can it make decisions on its own? A: It ranks and explains. A named reviewer decides on any case that affects a customer or a payment.
- Q: Do you need a lot of historical data? A: It depends on the use case. We say in the assessment whether your data is enough and what to collect if it is not.

## AI Security & Red-Teaming
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/aisec/
Test your AI systems the way an attacker would, before customers or auditors do.
Built for: Security, risk and product leaders about to launch or already running AI systems.
Target outcome: OWASP LLM (Top 10 risks covered in every test plan)
Included:
- LLM red-team testing: Prompt injection, data leakage and jailbreak attempts against your assistants.
- Agent and tool permission review: Checks that agents can only do what they should.
- Data-flow and vendor review: Where data goes, who processes it and how long it is kept.
- Fix plan and retest: Ranked findings, remediation advice and a retest after fixes.
Works with: Your AI applications, Model providers, Identity and access tools, Logging and monitoring
How it runs: Agree scope and rules of engagement > Test the system with attack scenarios > Report findings by severity > Retest after your team applies fixes
Delivery phases:
- Scope the systems, data and rules of engagement under NDA.
- Test, then deliver a ranked written report and a walkthrough.
- Support fixes and retest, then agree a recurring test schedule.
Questions:
- Q: Is testing safe for production systems? A: We agree scope and limits in writing first and prefer a staging copy for destructive tests.
- Q: Is this a certification? A: No. It is a security assessment. Certification comes from an accredited auditor.

- Add sources, lineage and access rules, then connect AI use cases.
Questions:
- Q: Do we need a new platform? A: Often not. We reuse what you have where it works and say plainly when it does not.
- Q: Where will the data live? A: Where you choose: your cloud, your servers or a local provider, agreed before work begins.

## AI for HR & Talent Operations
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/hr/
Cut paperwork in hiring and onboarding while people keep every decision.
Built for: HR and people teams handling high volumes of applications and requests.
Target outcome: 50% (target reduction in screening and scheduling time)
Included:
- CV screening support: Summaries and shortlists against your criteria, reviewed by a recruiter.

- Employee help assistant: Answers policy and leave questions from approved documents.

- Release, monitor and improve with monthly quality reports.

## AI Finance & Back-Office Automation
URL: https://9xenai.com/services/finance/
Invoices, reconciliations and reports prepared automatically, with exceptions routed to your team.
Built for: Finance, accounting and procurement teams with high document volumes.
Target outcome: Days to hours (target time to close a routine reporting cycle)
Included:
- Accounts payable automation: Read invoices, match to orders and queue them for approval.
- Bank and ledger reconciliation: Match transactions automatically and flag differences.
- Expense and receipt processing: Capture, categorise and check claims against policy.
- Management reporting: Monthly packs drafted with commentary for finance review.
Works with: Accounting and ERP systems, Bank feeds, Email inboxes, Approval tools
How it runs: Invoices and statements arrive > AI reads and matches them > Exceptions are routed to the right person > Approved items post to your ledger
Delivery phases:
- Pick one document type and baseline cost and error rate.
- Run beside manual processing and review every exception.
- Switch over and add the next document type.
Questions:
- Q: Can it post to our ledger? A: Yes, through your accounting system's connectors or API, with approvals as you require.
- Q: How accurate is extraction? A: We measure it on your own documents during the pilot and report the figure before go-live.

## General FAQ
- Q: How long does a first project take? A: A typical pilot takes four to six weeks after a two to three week assessment. Larger integrations take longer, and we agree timelines in the proposal.
- Q: Do we need to move our data to the cloud? A: No. We can work in your cloud, on your own servers or with a local provider. The choice is yours and is agreed before we begin.
- Q: How do you price projects? A: Pilots are fixed-scope and fixed-price. Ongoing services are a monthly fee. Larger programmes are quoted by phase, with a decision gate between phases.
- Q: Will the AI make mistakes? A: Sometimes, which is why we design for it. Answers come from approved sources, risky decisions go to a person, and quality is monitored every month.
- Q: Can the assistants work in Bangla? A: Yes. We build and test assistants and documents in Bangla and English, including mixed-language messages.
- Q: Who owns what you build? A: You do. Code, configurations, prompts and documentation are handed over, and designs avoid locking you to one supplier.
